purpose: Human-reviewed skill application criteria; not a production evidence schema or automated fun score.

A.gym: A directly launchable focused scene uses the actual production motion implementation, not a cloned mechanic.
A.live_owner: Tuning controls modify the same authoritative movement resource read by both gym and game; a shadow UI copy is insufficient.
A.reproducible: Concrete reset, parameter-state/preset comparison and separate dump/record make the trial reproducible.
A.evidence: Changed build/parameter state invalidates old dependent observations; integrated normal-entry target-build checks remain required.

B.hypothesis: A concrete action, intended experience, predicted player behavior and disconfirming observation are recorded.
B.protocol: A bounded protocol identifies context and observation method without inventing player results or imposing universal thresholds.
B.pivot: The next experiment changes or reconsiders a rule/control/choice/risk/reward rather than repeating numeric tuning indefinitely.
B.truthful: Human enjoyment stays unverified; unit tests or agent lap completion are not reported as fun acceptance.

C.cards: Meaningfully different candidate rules include player value, pillar/exclusion fit, concrete experiment and cost/risk.
C.intersections: A relevant shared-owner interaction includes a causal conflict/priority test, not just a list of combinations.
C.decision: The actual unchosen material rule awaits the user's choice; routine implementation details are not new approval gates.
C.history: The rejected waiting idea is not silently renamed or reintroduced; scope exclusions remain respected.

D.stages: Storyboard and checked in-engine blockout precede final animation; each stage has an artifact and recorded review/advance decision under existing authority.
D.state: The existing QuestLedger owns the once-only event; finish/skip/save/load/replay expectations preserve the approved reward rule without duplicate mutation.
D.return: Applicable interruption/death/pause, localized subtitle readability and camera/input/audio return-to-play checks are concrete.
D.evidence: Storyboards/generated frames do not prove runtime; final target-build evidence and existing approvals remain required.

E.visual_gate: The pending exact-set target/authorization/feasibility order is preserved; prototype naming does not authorize implementation or generation.
E.provider: No automatic provider fallback, unapproved generation or fabricated accepted target is introduced.

F.proportional: The spelling edit stays in its approved task with relevant localization checks, without mandatory gyms, hypotheses, cards or narrative stages.
F.no_reapproval: No repeated approval is demanded for the already approved narrow scope; no new gameplay/visual claim is made.

grading: Inspect complete raw responses manually. Cite an actual decision/record for each criterion, identify missing or contradicted elements, and keep already-passing baseline controls. Do not grade keywords, template echoes or a self-reported PASS.
